reasoning_traces.think:
The model ladder demonstrates that separation consistently drives predictive power, with its coefficient declining gradually from 0.0783 to 0.0524 as additional terms are introduced. This suggests that separation encodes a fundamental geometric property of receiver success, which is invariant to contextual factors like pre-snap positioning or target volume. Cushion, despite appearing contextually relevant, contributes only 0.001 R2 and shows minimal variation in its coefficient across models, indicating it is redundant noise. Position adds a meaningful 0.010 coefficient, confirming that role differentiation matters. Target volume fails to improve fit, implying it is a derived outcome rather than a driver. These findings support a dualism: geometric properties (separation) are causally effective, whereas contextual proxies (cushion, volume) are epiphenomenal. The failure mode lies in overfitting to superficial variables that lack structural significance. In GSI, this implies focusing on separation-derived metrics for probabilistic forecasting. In GSE, it means prioritizing separation-based state transitions over cushion-based positional logic.
